fields.Name: AIUsageDaily
fields.UserQuestion: What is our daily AI usage and cost broken down by model, agent, user, and scope?
fields.Description: Primary daily aggregation of AI usage facts. Computes model-call counts, token volumes, latencies (P50/P95), cache reads, and spend (by currency) across all dimensional attributes.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Live analytical query over [__mj].vwAIUsageFacts, one row per UTC day x dimension set x CostCurrency. Optional start/end ({{ start | sqlDate }}, {{ end | sqlDate }}) select whole days: every day that overlaps [start, end) is returned complete, by rounding start down and end up to UTC midnight and range-filtering the base RunAt column (sargable on IX_AIPromptRun_RunAt). The day is derived from RunAt by truncation and exposed as DayBucket (DATE) plus BucketStartUTC / BucketEndUTC. Parallel parents are counted in ParallelParents and excluded from every other measure. Latency percentiles are PERCENTILE_CONT window functions collapsed with MAX (SQL Server 2019+).
